newsitem.title: USA: Couple urges Mitchell to seek merger deal.
newsitem.headline: Couple urges Mitchell to seek merger deal.

text.p: Connecticut investors Jerome and Susan Davis said Thursday they advised Mitchell Bancorp to "explore opportunties to merger with a larger financial institution" unless it can producer greater returns.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the couple said it recommended Mitchell begin its merger search "upon its one year anniversary" if it cannot triple its substandard 3.5 percent return on equity.
A merger would produce a substantial premium over the current price of the common stock of $12.25 per share. On Nov 20, the stock closed at $13-1/8 per share.
The couple said Mitchell's first step would be to substantially reduce its capital, such as through a special dividend of $9.25 per share, which will still leave a capital ratio of 15.1 percent.
Davis's stake in the company stands at 9.98 percent, which was originally bought for investment purposes.
